What is Evidence

A Journal Built for Serious Traders

Evidence Trading is an analytics and journaling application for active traders. It gives you a structured way to record what you did, hard numbers on whether it worked, and a place to practise the parts that did not.

Getting trades in is not your job. Evidence syncs closed trades from the cTrader Open API — even while the app is closed, so a trade you took on your phone and forgot is journalled with its stop and target intact. It tracks trades live from MT5, ATAS, Quantower and TradingView, or imports a statement from 90+ brokers and platforms — futures, stocks, options, crypto and FX alike. Search your broker by name and the right format is picked for you. Not on the list? Map the columns once, save it as your own preset, done. And you can always write a trade by hand. Every broker connection is strictly read-only: Evidence never touches open positions, pending orders or any execution layer.

From there it goes further than a logbook. Edge Lab runs the quant work on your own history — risk of ruin, MFE/MAE, what-if scenarios, Monte-Carlo projections. Strategy Lab takes an idea you can describe in a sentence, turns it into rules you click together, and tests it over years of real market data — with a parameter optimiser and a walk-forward check that tells you whether the result was an edge or just curve fitting. Market Replay rewinds the real market to any past day so you can trade it forward candle by candle. And an AI coach reads the journal you are building: it grades closed trades, names the behavioural patterns behind your losing streaks, and warns you while you are opening a trade that looks like the last mistake.

Key Features

Five things have to happen before a journal changes anything: the trades have to get in, get recorded, get measured, get behaviourally honest — and then get practised. Evidence covers all five.

01Getting your trades inwithout typing them
🔄
cTrader Auto-Sync
Connects to the cTrader Open API and imports your closed trade history by itself — live and demo accounts. Switch on background sync and it keeps going with the app closed: we watch the account for you and capture stop-loss and take-profit while the position is still open, which is the only moment your broker will tell anyone. Access is read-only: Evidence can see trades, never place or change one.
cTrader API
📡
Live Auto-Tracking
Not on cTrader? A small tracker on MT5, ATAS, Quantower or TradingView reports your fills as they happen, so the journal fills itself there too.
4 platforms
🪙
Crypto — direct connection
Paste a read-only API key from Binance or Bybit and your fills arrive by themselves every ten minutes — app open or not, no export, no upload. Read-only means read-only: a key that is allowed to trade or withdraw is refused at the door, and the key is stored so that not even your own account can read it back.
Read-only keys
📘
Academy
Two courses to read. One on trading psychology — why traders who know exactly what to do still do something else: loss aversion, tilt, revenge trading, position size as a psychological decision. And one that writes your own strategy up as six chapters from your own description, so you can study the method you actually trade. Questions after every chapter, and it remembers where you stopped.

Tools
Practise, don't guess

Trade a day that already happened

Reading your statistics tells you what went wrong. It does not give you the reps to fix it. Market Replay rewinds the real market to any past date, hides everything after it, and lets you trade forward one candle at a time — on the same screen as your journal.

Not a simulator with made-up prices

Gold, the FX majors, the indices, crypto and oil — from free tick-accurate Dukascopy data, on timeframes from one minute to four hours. You buy at the ask and sell at the bid using the spread that actually existed at that moment, not a convenient constant.

Manage it like a real position
Several take-profits that scale out, break-even, a trailing stop, partial closes — and you can drag the stop or any target straight on the chart while the trade is running.
It admits what it cannot know
If your stop and your target were both inside one candle, no chart can say which came first. Evidence books the loss, marks the trade, and can settle it for real against the tick data. Most backtests quietly book the win.
Study it properly
Play, pause, step one candle, or drag the scrubber anywhere in the session. Trend lines, boxes, Fibonacci and notes stay glued to the candles — and your account, drawdown and profit factor are tracked the whole way.

Trust & Safety

Security & Data Privacy

Evidence requests a single cTrader Open API permission. This section documents exactly how that permission is used and the strict technical boundaries enforced by the application.

🛡️
Evidence Trading does not place, modify, or close trades.
The application contains no trade execution logic. It is technically incapable of interacting with open orders or positions.
Permission Requested
Access any available account info
This is the only cTrader API permission requested. Used exclusively to retrieve read-only data:
✓Retrieve closed trade history and fill data
✓Read account balance and equity snapshots
✓Access symbol and instrument metadata
✗Place, modify, or cancel any order — never used
✗Access funds or payment methods — never used
Data Handling
Privacy & Storage Policy
All data is handled with strict privacy standards:
✓Trade data stored securely in user's own cloud account
✓Data is never sold, shared, or transmitted to third parties
✓API tokens scoped to individual user sessions only
✗Credentials never stored in plain text or logged
✗No data aggregation across user accounts

Where your data lives — and how it is encrypted

Concrete answers, not "bank-grade security". Every claim below is repeated verbatim in our privacy policy.

Journal storage location
EU multi-region eur3
Google Cloud Firestore, replicated across Belgium and the Netherlands. Your trades, notes and screenshots do not leave the EU.
Encryption in transit
TLS 1.2+ (TLS 1.3 preferred)
HTTPS everywhere, HSTS on the domain. The broker bridge talks to the cTrader Open API over TLS as well — no plaintext hop anywhere in the chain.
Encryption at rest
AES-256
All stored data is AES-256 encrypted at rest by the platform. Broker refresh tokens get a second layer: AES-256-GCM application-level encryption, with the key held only in the server environment — never in the database.
Who can read your journal
Only you
Per-user database rules enforced server-side. Nothing is shared unless you publish it yourself — a community post, a report link or a mentor share you can revoke. No cross-account aggregation, no selling, no ad tracking.
Broker access
Read-only, revocable
One scope, read-only. There is no order-execution code in the product. Disconnect the broker or switch off background sync and the stored token is deleted.
Passwords & payments
We never see them
Authentication is handled by Firebase Auth (passwords stored only as a salted hash on their side). Card data goes straight to Stripe — we receive a customer and subscription id, never a card number.
Sub-processors
Named, not hidden
Google (Firebase), Cloudflare (workers), Render (broker bridge), Stripe (payments), Anthropic (AI coach — only if you use it), Dukascopy & Twelve Data (price data, no personal data sent). Non-EU transfers run on Standard Contractual Clauses.
Your rights
Export & delete, any time
Full CSV/JSON export from inside the app, one-click account deletion, and GDPR access/erasure requests answered within 30 days. Cancel your subscription in the app — no email required.

Something here unclear or missing? Write to us and we will answer it in writing — and put the answer on this page.
